reference.source: Independent fresh standalone pages using unmodified official Ant Design/React UMD. Public ConfigProvider descriptors, natural popup contents, real pointer/editor/context/resize/scroll actions. No Native code, expected geometry math, or Source result corrections.
reference.defaults: Stable token.motion=false and explicit public popupOverflow=viewport isolate width while preserving accepted Native TreeSelect alignment boundaries. Local and provider width own-key/value receipts come from the actual passed objects. Global getter is omitted for ordinary readers, present for scaled ShadowRoot and nested priority spies. Initial reader models are null except AutoComplete empty string; Cascader uses empty array.
reference.settle: Shared public driver moves the pointer outside after actions. Three identical complete projections, separated by two real paint frames and two tasks; consumer-owned actual head styles copied to an owned ShadowRoot.
reference.declarationDiscrepancy: Pinned ConfigProvider declaration is boolean; its docs and actual runtime forward numbers. These JavaScript numeric-provider scenarios preserve that operational contract.
reference.comparisonScope: Actual nested owner defaults, local width/container priorities and compact popup CSS. Calendar and ColorPicker local container behavior stays distinct from global getter arguments. Existing nested layout contracts remain independent.
